authority: Execution interface for the film project. Subordinate to the Master (FROZEN), Runtime Constitution, CTO Directives and ODG_AUTONOMOUS_WORK_PROTOCOL.json. On any disagreement, those win. This contract governs the self-contained film workflow in docs/film-factory/ (which the engineering runtime does not touch).

invariants.text: ODG owns end-to-end orchestration and continuous improvement; technical providers execute only bounded, authorized tasks.
The film is produced through ONE chronological, scene-linked master timeline (f11-film-timeline.json is SSOT).
Every asset has a purpose, scene assignment, continuity constraints, acceptance criteria and a cost record.
No paid generation without a preflight check, a known worst-case exposure and an authorized budget.
F10 remains immutable (SHA256SUMS verified). F11 changes are traceable and respect required approval gates.
Final category distribution is FIXED at 64/13/10/5/5/3 and MEASURED from the actual rendered timeline, never claimed from estimates or renormalized.
Quality, licensing and actual evidence take precedence over optimistic reporting.
Every interruption or task exit updates the canonical compass (ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md) with a verified next action.
Every future invocation automatically loads this operating contract (via session-resume.mjs / operating-contract.mjs).
The active production cap is the t1 ledger ceiling (€15). A forecast (e.g. €130/€167-401) is NOT authorization.

exitRecordSchema.note: A mission exit (including a BLOCKED exit) MUST write a compass entry satisfying this schema. nextAction must be a concrete, dependency-ready operation, not 'continue'.

resumeProtocol: 1. Read ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md head (latest entry) — the fast-resume pointer.
2. node docs/film-factory/pipeline/session-resume.mjs — loads this contract, recovers the verified checkpoint, retrieves applicable lessons, prints the exact next action.
3. Verify repo HEAD/branch/worktree; reconcile any compass<->repo mismatch (reality wins).
4. Select the next dependency-ready action from the timeline; run its preflight guards before any paid call.
5. On exit, write a compass entry satisfying exitRecordSchema.
